poster.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: finished Korean mobile community promotional poster, portrait 2:3, high resolution. This is an advance reveal of an upcoming 1v1 strategy card PVP mode, not an already released event. Render the full poster including crisp, flawlessly spelled Korean typography.
Primary request: A premium, dramatic game poster for "클래식 멸망전", with a magnificent ancient colosseum arena and a witty newspaper feature "콜로세움 일보". The focus is equal +10 rental conditions and strategic card composition.
Scene: a monumental circular Roman-inspired fantasy colosseum at twilight, vast tiered stone stands, towering gates, narrow beams of arena light, fine dust and subtle embers. A clean central arena floor forms the backdrop for two opposed sets of elegant card backs, restrained jade-green and fiery amber light meeting in the middle. Cards are game strategy cards, not poker cards. No people or mercenary characters and no real person's face. Make the arena illustration substantial and cinematic, not a flat text flyer.
Visual style: professionally art-directed premium Korean game key art, realistic richly textured stone and brushed metal, atmospheric depth, sharp compositional focus. Midnight navy metallic ornament with aged gold edges and small vivid chartreuse highlights, consistent with a fantasy game's navy panel and lime action-button identity. Avoid excessive bloom or clutter.
Composition and hierarchy: generous safe margins; large, exceptionally readable Korean title in the top third, pale ivory embossed metal with restrained antique gold bevel. Arena and dramatic two-sided card duel across the middle. Four compact readable rules in a polished navy metal plaque in the lower middle. A deliberately designed cream newsprint inset with black letterpress typography and a thin red editorial stamp near the lower third, visually distinct from the dark arena. This newspaper inset is a clear secondary feature, does not cover the title or rules. Footer has an elegant upcoming release line. Balance imagery and typography, preserve breathing room, highly polished composition designed to be readable on a phone.
TEXT: Use exactly these Korean strings, with no additional invented copy, no dates, no rewards, no URL, no launch button. All Korean characters must be correct, high contrast, no tiny type.
Top small kicker: "신규 PVP 콘텐츠 · 사전 공개"
Very large main title on two lines: "클래식" / "멸망전"
Tagline below title: "승부는 전략으로. 패배는 기사로."
In the arena, an elegant large "1 : 1", with the smaller line "운영자 초대 매치"
Highlight line: "전부 +10 대여 · 순수 전략전"
Rules plaque, three lines:
"제니스 등급까지 편성"
"FUR · 슈퍼스타 · 아이콘 제외"
"용병 없음 · 마법카드 사용 가능"
Newspaper inset masthead: "콜로세움 일보"
Newspaper bold main headline: "패자는 오늘의 1면!"
Newspaper supporting line: "패배자 전용 굴욕 팝업"
Bottom small line: "운영자 ON / OFF · 초대 팝업 수락 후 참전"
Bottom larger final line: "COMING SOON"
Constraints: no trademarked character designs, no logos, no gore, no rude slurs, no private nicknames, no fake screenshots, no weapon-bearing mercenaries, no QR code. Spell "멸망전" and "콜로세움 일보" accurately. Show +10, not +100 or +1O. All panel contents must stay within safe margins, no cropped typography. Opaque fully illustrated background.

arena.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a premium 16:9 landscape fantasy game colosseum arena environment, for the playable lobby of a Korean strategy card game. Huge ancient circular stone arena at blue-hour twilight with navy sky, monumental tiered stands, aged stone archways and bronze details, one tall central entrance far in the background, subdued green banners to left and deep red banners to right, warm braziers and tiny embers, rich cinematic depth. Low slightly elevated wide view of the EMPTY flat sand-and-stone arena floor. The floor occupies the lower half with roomy empty space for two opposing card formations. Match the visual atmosphere of a grand realistic game promotional illustration: midnight blue, aged gold, soft warm edge lights, restrained jade green. Detailed architecture at perimeter, center clean and readable. No characters, no combatants, no cards, no lettering, no logo, no UI panels or buttons, no watermark, no broken bridge. A polished cohesive game background, not a photograph.
